items.q: Each picture stands for 3. There are 21 things in all. Two rows have 3 pictures and 2 pictures. How many pictures does the third row need?
items.hint: Count the pictures in all. Take the two rows away.
steps: The two rows have 3 and 2 pictures: 5 pictures.

slips.say: That is how many things the third row has. Count how many pictures that is.
